newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Siu-Fung in HK$400 mln rights issue plan.
newsitem.headline: Siu-Fung in HK$400 mln rights issue plan.

text.p: Siu-Fung Ceramics Holdings plans to raise HK$400 million before expenses by an issue of 575.09 million rights shares at HK$0.70 per rights share on the basis of two rights shares for every five existing shares held, the company said in a statement published on Monday.
Siu-fung shares ended at HK$0.74 per share on Friday.

The company said HK$192.5 million would be used to repay indebtness in connection with the purchase of the ceramics production equipemnt business of Erich Netzsch GmbH & Co Holdings Kg of Germany, a worldwide supplier of turnkey ceramics production systems, earlier in March.
The remainder of the proceeds will be used to provide additional funding for the company's further expansion, it said.
The rights issue will complete on November 12, it said.
The company's chairman Siegfried Lee held 778.91 million shares or 54.18 percent of the company as on September 27.
The ceramic production systems and tiles maker on Friday reported an interim loss of HK$252.19 million for the first half of 1996, compared with HK$102.72 million profit in a year earlier period.
